entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. Order number is VF88602.
Okay, I'm pulling up order VF88602 now. I see it was for a pair of Pro-Level cycling shoes. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them?
They don't fit. They gave me blisters.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Comfort is key. Just to be sure, was this an issue with the shoe itself, or perhaps the placement of the cleats?
The shoes. I just want a refund.
Of course. Let me just check the purchase date for you... okay. I see they were delivered 37 days ago. That's well within our 90-day return window, so I can definitely process that return for you.

I also see you're a VIP member with us, and we truly value your business. Since these cycling shoes caused you discomfort, I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee and added a $25 credit to your account for the inconvenience. You'll get a full refund as soon as we receive the item.

Absolutely. I've just emailed the pre-paid return label to the address on file. Just package the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
